correctness.rationale: The proof precisely treats 2 <= k < n < kU, proves coordinatewise closure of lifted gap-feasible vectors and a strict-slack monotone interpolation lemma, then preserves cyclic order to replace every ambient route by an admissible route without added steps. A separate flow-conservation and zero-flow-cut argument yields the exact circular median distance. n=3 and both sharp boundary examples are checked. Independent graph-definition and BFS computations test 162372 ordered pairs for n=3..17 without being treated as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The primary paper proves connectivity but leaves shortest paths undetermined. Exact preservation of the ambient token metric for all pairs is a structural strengthening and gives an explicit median-cost algorithm and shortest admissible routes on infinitely many graphs. The sharp saturated failure and the nonconvex geodesic example distinguish metric isometry from weak connectedness or full path convexity.
